description: A code symbol of a left angle bracket, a forward slash and a right angle bracket sits between two larger outer brackets, each bent like half a hexagon with a flat vertical middle.
Two curved hoses sweep in from the upper and lower left and merge into a banded nozzle facing right. Three short spray strokes fan out from the nozzle's open end.
Two rounded square blocks sit side by side, joined by a short horizontal link. An arrow extends to the right from the second block, whose left edge is slightly pinched where the link enters.
A large circle carries a small ring node on its left and right edges, joined by a horizontal line through the centre. A square with concave, pinched sides sits at the middle of that line.
A six-lobed gear with a solid centre dot sits at the top as the root of a tree. A stem drops to a horizontal bar that branches down to three small circular nodes.
Three elliptical orbits cross at equal angles to form an atom. A small hexagon with a centre dot sits where they intersect as the nucleus.
Two rows of large digits form a block of binary code: 0 1 0 on the top row and 0 0 1 beneath it, with the digits aligned in columns.
A hand rises from the lower edge and bends over at the top, its curled index finger and thumb pinching a small square chip with short pins at the upper left.
A tower crane stands at the left with a triangular-trussed jib across the top. A short hook line hangs from the jib to a rounded crate marked with code brackets around a slash.
A dome-shaped parachute canopy connects by three straight cords to a rounded crate hanging below. The crate face carries code brackets around a slash.
A beetle seen from above, with an oval body split by a central vertical line and a rounded head with two short antennae. Three jointed legs spread from each side.
An isometric cube sits at the centre between two long horizontal arrows: one along the top pointing right and one along the bottom pointing left.
Two rows of bold binary digits, 10100 above 01100, sit over two parallel wavy water lines that run across the full width.
Three bars of decreasing height step down from left to right over a wavy waterline. A small stacked database cylinder floats above the shortest bar at the upper right.
A tall single database cylinder with an elliptical top rim. Two short horizontal label lines, the upper one longer, sit centred in its lower body.
A stacked database cylinder with two band lines sits at the top. A stem drops to a horizontal bar that branches down to three small square nodes.
Three ring nodes in a left column connect by straight lines to two ring nodes on the right. The links cross in the middle, forming an X between the lower and upper rows.
A wide database cylinder with two horizontal band lines has a jagged crack running down from its top rim through the upper bands.
A small square on the left branches into three arrows pointing up-right, right and down-right. Each arrow ends beside one of three stacked squares in a column on the right.
An isometric box is divided by grid lines into compartments across its top and front faces. A small circle sits over a gap at its lower-left edge. The reference is hard to read.
A flame with two rounded tongues rises from the top of a horizontal brick wall built from three staggered courses.
Three horizontal bars step diagonally from upper left to lower right. Elbowed connector lines join the end of each bar to the next bar below.
A small square at the top drops a stem that splits into a central line and two outward arches, each ending at one of three small squares; the middle square tapers slightly.
A square parent at the top connects through a stem and a horizontal bar to two larger squares at the lower left and lower right.
A ring node at the top drops a stem to a bar with rounded corners that branches to three rounded squares in a row below.
Three horizontal bars stack on the left, each joined by a short line to a vertical spine on the right that rises above the top bar.
A square parent at the top connects through a stem and a horizontal bar to two ring nodes at the lower left and lower right.
A wide rounded bar at the top branches to two rounded bars beneath it, and each of those has a second rounded bar directly below, forming two short columns.

Open triangles point outward around a vertical line: a flag-like one at the top right, one on each side, a large one at the lower left and a small one at the lower right, linked by crossing diagonals. The reference is hard to read.
A large ring on a vertical stem rises from a central marker made of a ring over a flattened diamond. Two matching markers flank it lower down on the left and right.
A large ring hub at the top sends two short diagonal branches to small ring nodes on each side and a stem down to a ring marker with a diamond base.
A circle outline has three ring nodes on its upper-right rim, linked to each other. Straight lines fan out from a single point at the lower left of the circle to each node.
Two six-lobed gears with solid centres sit side by side at the top. Below them, four vertical pins of varying heights, each topped by a small ring, stand in a row.
A diagonal arrow points from an upper-left ring node toward the lower right. A wide curve loops from an upper-right node down beneath the arrowhead and back up to a ring node at the middle left.
A rounded bowl-shaped outline opens at the top, where a tall exclamation mark stands with its tapered stroke rising above the rim and its dot resting inside the bowl.
A wide bowl-shaped vessel floats above two wavy water lines. Two nested signal arcs, the upper one wider, rise from the centre of its open top.
Three horizontal capsules stack vertically. The lower two are offset and each shows a curved end cap on one side, like rolled logs, while the top one is plain.
A four-pointed star with a small right-pointing chevron at its centre. Four small arrowhead-shaped sparks point inward toward it from the diagonals.
Two open hands rise from the lower left and lower right with fingers curved upward. A tilted jigsaw puzzle piece floats between them near the top.
Three rounded squares form a pyramid: two side by side at the bottom and one centred above them, its lower edge touching the tops of both.
Three rounded squares form a pyramid: two side by side at the bottom and one centred above them with a clear gap between the rows.
Three rounded squares form a pyramid: two side by side at the bottom and one centred above them with a clear gap between the rows.
Two small winged rockets point downward side by side, each with two short vertical exhaust strokes above it. A shallow curved horizon line runs beneath them. The reference is hard to read.
A six-lobed gear with a ring-and-dot centre sits at the top of a tree. A stem drops to a horizontal bar that branches down to three circular nodes.
A six-lobed gear with a ring-and-dot centre sits at the top of a tree. A stem drops to a horizontal bar that branches down to three rounded square nodes.
An isometric cube sits at the top of a tree. A stem drops from its lower vertex to a horizontal bar that branches down to three ring nodes.
A rounded square at the top connects through a stem and a horizontal bar to three rounded squares in an evenly spaced row below.
An upright paper scroll with a curled tab at the top right and a rolled end at the bottom left. Two horizontal text lines sit on the upper part of the sheet.
A shield with straight sides tapering to a point at the bottom holds a large numeral 5 with a flat top stroke and a rounded lower bowl.
Two concentric open arcs wrap around from the bottom to the upper right. A circle sits at the lower right where the inner arc drops down to meet it.
A tall rounded block has a small round knob on its top and bottom edges. Two short pointed tabs project from its left side, and a wider rectangle overlaps its right side.
A clenched hand rises from the lower edge, its thumb and curled index finger closing around a small square chip with crossing pins at the upper left.
Three curved hooks form a triangle. Each side is a straight stroke ending in a rounded loop that curls toward the next corner, at the top, lower left and lower right.
Three hexagonal nuts, each with a smaller hexagonal hole, cluster together: two stacked on the left and one set to the right between them.
